---
title: "Stage 7.4 — Cross-curve persistence comparison"
output: html_document

params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "inspect"             # inspect | report
  optimization_curves: null   # null = all completed Stage 6 curves
  main_curve: "q50"
  rank_method: "abf"          # abf | caz1 | caz2 | cazmax
---

Stage 7.4 is report-only. It requires a complete Stage 7.2 exact-target library
and regenerates trajectories, statistics, and plain tables in memory. It never
reads the rank raster, loads reconstruction kernels, or writes derived caches.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage74_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("7.4_cross_curve_priority_comparison.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage74")
rmd_params <- configured$params
config <- stage74_config(rmd_params)
run_states <- read_completed_stage6_states(config)
target_plan <- build_benchmark_target_plan(run_states)
```

```{r inspect}
stage74_readiness <- inspect_benchmark_library(config, target_plan)
print(stage74_readiness)
```

```{r results, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (identical(config$mode, "report")) {
  stage74_result <- run_stage74(config)
}
```

```{r primary-results}
if (identical(config$mode, "report")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage74_result", "results")
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$primary_late)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$primary_sequence)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$primary_area)
}
```

```{r robustness-matrices}
if (identical(config$mode, "report")) {
  require_chunk_object("stage74_result", "results")
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$robustness)
  lapply(stage74_result$report_tables$late_matrices, print)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$sequence_mean)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$sequence_directions)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$area_mean)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$area_directions)
  print(stage74_result$report_tables$stability)
}
```

```{r artifact-summary}
print(benchmark_library_index(config, target_plan, validate = FALSE))
cat("Runtime log:", config$paths$report_log, "\n")
```
